description:
This Request for Information (RFI) and Sources Sought Notice is for market research purposes only.

The District of Columbia National Guard (DCNG) requires the immediate delivery of twenty (20) large, Level 6 Armored SUVs, each with a minimum seating capacity for six (6) individuals. This protection level is required to defend against 7.62mm rifle rounds, ensuring robust security for all occupants.

CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: Companies should only respond to this notice if they have qualifying vehicles currently in stock and available for immediate shipment.

Previous market research indicates that models with the necessary protection levels are available. Please respond with a list of your available, in-stock options that are ready for immediate delivery.

Cadillac Escalade ESV

Chevrolet Suburban

GMC Yukon XL

Toyota Land Cruiser

Lexus LX 600

Lincoln Navigator L

Response Information: Please contact the Contracting Officer, LTC Paul Caldwell at joseph.p.caldwell.mil@mail.mil and the Contract Specialist, SGT Terreance White at terrance.d.white7.mil@army.mil with any inquires or interest in response to this Sources Sought. Please include your CAGE Code, Business Size and Socioeconomic Designation if applicable. Please provide supporting information demonstrating your company is fully capable of meeting the government's requirements to include past federal contract numbers.
